__________________________________________ For Petitioner : Mr. Jiya-Ur-Rahman F o r R e s p o n d e n t : M r . R i s h i r a j S i n g h R a t h o r e , P . P .
__________________________________________ HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE SABINA Order 23/11/2017 Petitioner has filed this petition under Section 439 Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 seeking regular bail in F.I.R. No.220/2017 registered at Police Station Maniya, District Dholpur for offence under Sections 420, 272, 273, 120-B Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 57 of Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 5.11.2017.
Name of the petitioner was disclosed by his co-accused Rambraj Singh.
The said co-accused has been granted bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this court.
Case of the petitioner is on a better footing than co-accused Rambraj Singh.
Learned State Counsel on the other hand, has opposed the petition.

(2 of 2) Since, co-accused Rambraj Singh has been granted bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this petition is allowed.
Petitioner be admitted to bail subject to satisfaction of the Trial Court.
